name: sandbox-platform-lb
description: HAProxy load balancer for sandbox platform runtime agents

baremetal.description: Static config — fixed IPs, no service discovery. For local dev and single-node baremetal.

server.description: Dynamic config via consul-template. Backends auto-discovered from Consul. For multi-node baremetal or self-managed server.

backends.name: sandbox_microvm
backends.notes: slowstart 60s karena FC VM butuh warm-up. 503 dari /health = node overloaded, HAProxy auto-exclude.

swap_for_cloud.aws: adapters/loadbalancer/aws_alb.py — ALB target groups per tier, health check via /health
swap_for_cloud.gcp: adapters/loadbalancer/gcp_lb.py  — GCP Backend Services per tier
swap_for_cloud.note: Cloud LB tidak perlu file config ini. Adapter langsung call cloud API untuk register/deregister backend.
